object: the poslist buffer a lookahead reader is positioned in
lifetime_ender: the in-place rewrite's own append grows the buffer: sqlite3Fts5PoslistWriterAppend opens with fts5BufferGrow(pBuf, 5+5+5), so once the output passes nSpace-15 sqlite3Fts5BufferSize reallocs the buffer the lookahead reader is positioned in

note: Trigger replaced 2026-10-29 and the defect is now reached. The old trigger ran NEAR(quick brown, 3) over two short rows; the in-place rewrite did run under live lookahead readers, but nSpace doubles from 64 and sqlite3Fts5PoslistWriterAppend only reallocs when the output length passes nSpace-15, so the poslist has to land in (nSpace-15, nSpace]. Swept on the host: poslists of 56-66, 120-130 and 252-256 bytes report heap-use-after-free and every other length is silent. 'a b' sixty times puts 'a' on positions 0,2,4,... and 'b' on 1,3,5,..., so each phrase poslist is 3 bytes for the first entry plus one per delta = 62, and NEAR/1 keeps every entry so the writer tracks the reader byte for byte. Host ASan (shared/run-host-asan.py, both controls satisfied): heap-use-after-free, a 1-byte read 52 bytes inside the freed 64-byte region in sqlite3Fts5PoslistNext64 under fts5LookaheadReaderNext, freed by sqlite3_realloc under sqlite3Fts5PoslistWriterAppend -- the read and the free are both inside fts5ExprNearIsMatch.
